# Getting help

## Questions

Open an issue using the [Question form](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/srm-speed-torque-control/issues/new?template=question.yml) for questions about the SRM equations, test cases, or simulation setup.

## Bugs and feature requests

Use the [issue forms](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/srm-speed-torque-control/issues/new/choose).

## Security problems

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What we do not support

- Versions earlier than `v1.2.0`
- Running `src/SRM_Project.slx` without a licensed MATLAB/Simulink installation (we provide `validation/srm_validation.py` as the open-source Python mirror)
